_comment: F-Droid per-app signing keys for browsers that the F-Droid main repo rebuilds and
re-signs (Anti-Repaint deterministic per-app keys). Merged ONLY into the fdroid
nogms builds, where a re-signed browser must keep warning.
Rationale: an fdroid-flavor Pass install is itself distributed through the F-Droid
ecosystem, so its users' trust root is F-Droid's build pipeline. Trusting F-Droid's
per-app keys there is consistent; elsewhere it is not.
Policy: add an entry only after verifying the fingerprint with apksigner against the
APK served by https://f-droid.org/repo/, and record the exact artifact in _source.
Vendor-signed upstream entries still apply (merges are additive per package).

info._source: https://f-droid.org/repo/com.duckduckgo.mobile.android_52960000.apk verified with apksigner 36.1.0 on 2026-10-15 (DN: CN=FDroid, O=fdroid.org)
https://f-droid.org/repo/org.mozilla.fennec_fdroid_1570020.apk verified with apksigner 36.1.0 on 2026-10-15 (DN: CN=FDroid, O=fdroid.org)
